messages:
Priya: Quick follow-up from the outage yesterday — we still have a few open items that touch customer comms and a recurring failure pattern. Need owners and realistic dates. Can we quick-assign? @Gina @Noah @Carlos
Noah: I can own the recurrence deep-dive. I'll gather traces, heap dumps, and deploy history. Target: Friday EOD for mitigation recommendations.
Gina: I'll draft the external-facing note. Prefer short, plain language and a tiny FAQ. First pass by today 18:00 PT.
Carlos: Legal/security constraints: we can share a condensed RCA summary upon request; full internal artifacts require an account-holder approval + DPA/contract checks for enterprise customers. I'll confirm exact wording tomorrow AM.
ops-bot: Checklist created for thread 2460078901: [1] External plain-language note [2] Status page brief update [3] RCA sharing template + opt-in wording [4] Recurrence analysis + mitigation plan [5] Tag incidents for trend queries. Artifacts: https://internal.redwood/incidents/2460078901
Priya: For the status page language, let's avoid 'root cause' and avoid technical jargon. Possible phrasing: 'We identified a software issue in the authentication service that increased errors for some requests.' Thoughts?
Gina: Agree on avoiding 'root cause' externally. Suggest 'cause confirmed' instead of 'identified'—it's a bit less absolute. Also add 'what we're doing' bullet list: short-term mitigation + long-term fix.
Noah: Ops notes: recurring spikes line up with auth-worker memory growth after ~18 hours of uptime; likely a leak in the third-party session lib, but still investigating. I've uploaded the timeline and sample heap dump to the incident tracker.
Carlos: For the customer-facing RCA opt-in, proposed sentence: "Customers impacted by this incident may request a summary RCA. Internal logs and debugging artifacts will only be shared with account-holder approval." I'll add the exact consent flow tomorrow.
Gina: Draft external note (first pass):
```
We experienced elevated authentication errors from 2026-03-12 08:10 to 08:45 UTC impacting a subset of customers. Cause confirmed: memory growth in the authentication worker increased retries and led to degraded responses. We deployed a fix and verified recovery.
What we're doing:
- Notified impacted customers and emailing account contacts
- Updating the status page with incident details
- Conducting a recurrence analysis and timeline
If you were impacted and would like the RCA summary, please reply to your account contact or open a support ticket.
```
Priya: Looks good. Two small asks: 1) add a one-line apology/upfront acknowledgement, 2) add a link to the status page incident after Jordan posts it.
Noah: I'll create a "recurring-incidents" tag in the tracker and backfill related incidents from the last 120 days. That will help Product + SRE spot patterns. ETA for backfill: 48 hours.
Gina: Status page update plan: short blurb + link to external note + timestamp + 'resolved' marker. I'll coordinate with Platform Console team so the incident link resolves. Target: tomorrow 09:00 PT.
Carlos: Once I confirm the opt-in wording, I'll drop the template here. Quick note: for enterprise customers we need to route RCA requests via their TAMs.
Priya: Finalize owners/times in thread: Gina  external note by today 18:00 PT; Gina  status page update by tomorrow 09:00 PT; Noah  recurrence analysis & mitigation suggestions by Friday EOD; Carlos  RCA-sharing policy + template by tomorrow 10:00 PT. If no objections I'll mark these in the action tracker and tag Product/Comms.
Gina: No objections. I'll push the note for an quick review once done.
Noah: Noted. I'll include suggested instrumentation and a short rollback plan in the mitigation doc.
ops-bot: Action tracker updated: https://internal.redwood/incidents/2460078901/actions (owners assigned).
Priya: Thanks team. I'll do a final sweep and loop in Customer Success for direct outreach.
